migration: 1.0.0 to 1.1.0: anchors made game-agnostic (constants live in the game profile), lens gates added; ids, weights and passAt unchanged; 1.1.0 to 1.1.1: gameProfile generalized to your-game-profile for the public kit and hash recomputed with the documented kit algorithm (spec/RUBRIC_HASH.md); ids, weights, anchors and passAt unchanged. 1.1.1 to 1.1.3: Evidence descriptions and fixture working directories now refer to the distributed kit. 1.1.3 to 1.1.4: Empty samples and zero case counts earn U. Computed lines require the declared evidence type. The profile supplies reward size, occupancy and padding targets. 1.1.4 to 1.1.5: Adds a per-combination atlas matrix, frame and pivot comparisons on the damage path, and a separate tier separation check. 1.1.5 to 1.2.0: Line, pillar and anchor wording made genre-neutral (ids, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged); adds owner-selected not-applicable profiles no-height-layer, no-item-tiers, no-install-icons, no-hit-shapes. 1.2.0 to 1.3.0: Evidence pack names made genre-neutral (rewardArt to itemArt; maxRarityDeltaE to maxTierPaletteDeltaE; minRewardPx to minItemArtPx; rarity to tierPalette; elevation to heightLayer; damage-path to gameplay-path). Scoring, weights, conditions and pass marks unchanged; rename these fields in packs made for 1.2.0.
levels: Levels 0 to 4, or U. U earns zero points and excludes the line weight from measured coverage. Record skipped execution as NOT_RUN.

verdict: PASS, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED is reported separately from the grade and coverage. An unresolved P0 blocks.
source: Decoded assets, atlas samples and hit-shape overlays captured at gameplay scale.
samplePolicy: Each computed metric group needs a nonempty population. Use the listed sample arrays or positive integer case counts. For other groups supply a positive integer measuredCases from the capture. Empty inputs or zero measured cases earn U and zero points. A measured zero failures is valid.

no-height-layer.reason: The game has no height or depth layer for overlapping objects. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

no-item-tiers.reason: Items have no colour tiers or rarity levels. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

no-install-icons.reason: The game ships no installable web or app icons from this atlas; their 20 points are shared over the other lines. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.

no-hit-shapes.reason: Sprites carry no gameplay hit, collision or click shapes; their 20 points are shared over the other lines. Select only after the owner approves it, before scoring.
